sources.evidence: The official Casa BACARDÍ page identifies the Cataño, Puerto Rico site as the world’s largest rum distillery and describes a working BACARDÍ aging warehouse at the site.
The official BACARDÍ sustainability page describes the Puerto Rico distillery and explicitly references fermentation, distillation and production operations at Casa BACARDÍ.
The official Casa BACARDÍ shop lists BACARDÍ Superior as white rum from Bacardí Corporation, Cataño, Puerto Rico.
The official Casa BACARDÍ experience page states that Casa BACARDÍ Special Reserve is bottled, sealed and labeled on site and identifies it as Bacardí Corporation, Cataño, Puerto Rico.
